body:
Make a Ten: 1. 15 (9 + 1 + 5 = 10 + 5). 2. 12 (8 + 2 + 2 = 10 + 2). 3. 12 (7 + 3 + 2 = 10 + 2). 4. Take 2 from the 4 to make 8 into 10; 10 + 2 = 12.
Fact Families and Missing Numbers: 1. 3. 2. 7. 3. 8. 4. 6. 5. 4 + 7 = 11, 7 + 4 = 11, 11 - 4 = 7, 11 - 7 = 4. 6. 8 shells (? + 5 = 13).
True or False?: 1. True. 2. True (8 - 1 is 7). 3. True; changing the order of the numbers does not change the total (both are 7). 4. False; 4 + 1 is 5 and 5 + 2 is 7. 5. True (both are 12). 6. 13 (4 + 6 = 10, 10 + 3 = 13). 7. 12 flowers (5 + 5 = 10, 10 + 2 = 12).
Strategies Check: 1. 14 (9 + 1 + 4 = 10 + 4). 2. 15 (7 + 7 = 14, 14 + 1 = 15, or 8 + 8 - 1). 3. 8. 4. 7. 5. True; both sides are 10. 6. 14 (3 + 7 = 10, 10 + 4 = 14). 7. 7 children.
Scoring tip: on "I can use a strategy", count the strategy the student shows, not only the answer: a right answer reached by counting all from 1 is Getting there. For problem 7, a student who writes 11 + 4 = 15 has added instead of finding the change; reteach with ? as the missing part.
title: Answer key: Adding and Subtracting Strategies
